treatment_method: PTau covalently grafted onto NYCO fabric
evidence: Primary article abstract reports exact matched-state LOI 36.7% and TGA char residue 37.2 wt% at 800 °C for PTau-NYCO; source materials information identifies the NYCO twill as 12.5/87.5 nylon/cotton, 150 g/m².
source_title: Improving the fire performance and washing durability of nylon-cotton blend fabrics by the incorporation taurine derivatives
limitations: Accessible public text does not expose TGA atmosphere, gas flow or heating rate. Exclude from strict condition-controlled scatter until those fields are verified. The 29.2% LOI after 40 laundering cycles is not paired with the as-prepared TGA row.

treatment_chemistry: oxidized tannin (OTA) + keratin (Ker) co-deposition followed by Fe3+ chelation
treatment_method: OTA/Ker co-deposition on PA66 followed by Fe3+ chelation
evidence: Primary ScienceDirect article reports exact matched-state R800=21.6% under N2 and LOI=28.5%; materials section identifies plain PA66 fabric, 105 g/m², supplied by Suzhou Xing'anling Textile Co.
source_title: Protein-tannin interactions towards fabricating flame-retardant, UV-resistance, antibacterial and mechanical-reinforced PA66 fabric
limitations: TGA heating rate and N2 flow are not exposed in the accessible public text. Exclude from strict heating-rate-controlled scatter until full method is verified.
